text.name: Jawbreaker: Fall of the Taliban
text.rules: Record "swift campaign". LIO spends 2 points. At the end of this turn, SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: A small CIA team code-named Jawbreaker landed in Afghanistan's Panjshir Valley on 26 September 2001; with US air support and Afghan allies, the Taliban lost Kabul on 13-14 November 2001.
